Callout.Name: Street Racing
Callout.Message: Two vehicles racing, callers reporting high speed.
Callout.Advisory: Both vehicles northbound, side by side.

Script.Line: Two cars side by side at well over a hundred.
They have gone up the road towards the retail park.
There are people stood on the verge watching them. That is the worst of it.

Lines.Approach: Two cars side by side at speed heading north. Do not race them - get in front of them.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
